    <h1 {...{
      "id": "trino-extractor"
    }}>{`Trino Extractor`}</h1>
    <h2 {...{
      "id": "overview"
    }}>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`The Trino Extractor is a comprehensive metadata extraction utility designed for Apache Atlas integration with Trino. It provides discovery, extraction, and synchronization of Trino metadata including catalogs, schemas, tables, and columns into Apache Atlas for enhanced data governance and metadata management.`}</p>
    <h2 {...{
      "id": "key-features"
    }}>{`Key Features`}</h2>
    <h3 {...{
      "id": "metadata-extraction"
    }}>{`Metadata Extraction`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Comprehensive Discovery`}</strong>{`: Automatically discovers and extracts metadata from Trino catalogs, schemas, tables, and columns`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`JDBC-Based Connection`}</strong>{`: Uses standard Trino JDBC driver for reliable connectivity`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Selective Extraction`}</strong>{`: Supports extraction for specific catalog, schema, or table names`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3 {...{
      "id": "atlas-integration"
    }}>{`Atlas Integration`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Entity Management`}</strong>{`: Creates and updates Atlas entities for Trino metadata objects`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Relationship Mapping`}</strong>{`: Establishes proper hierarchical relationships between catalogs, schemas, tables, and columns`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Synchronization`}</strong>{`: Maintains consistency by removing Atlas entities that no longer exist in Trino`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Connector Support`}</strong>{`: Specialized handling for Trino connectors for which Atlas captures the metadata through individual Hook like Hive, Iceberg`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3 {...{
      "id": "scheduling--automation"
    }}>{`Scheduling & Automation`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cron-based Scheduling`}</strong>{`: Supports automated periodic extraction using cron expressions`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`One-time Execution`}</strong>{`: Can be run as a single extraction job`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Error Handling`}</strong>{`: Robust error handling with detailed logging`}</li>
    </ul>

      "id": "architecture"
    }}>{`Architecture`}</h2>
    <SyntaxHighlighter language="text" style={theme.github} mdxType="SyntaxHighlighter">

│ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ ┌─────────────┐ │
│ │  Catalogs   │◄┼────┼►│ JDBC Client │ │    │ │  Entities   │ │
│ └─────────────┘ │    │ └─────────────┘ │    │ └─────────────┘ │
│ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ ┌─────────────┐ │
│ │   Schemas   │ │    │ │ Extraction  │◄┼────┼►│Relationships│ │
│ └─────────────┘ │    │ │   Service   │ │    │ └─────────────┘ │
│ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ └─────────────┘ │    │ ┌─────────────┐ │
│ │   Tables    │ │    │ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ │  Lineage    │ │
│ └─────────────┘ │    │ │Atlas Client │◄┼────┼►│    Data     │ │
│ ┌─────────────┐ │    │ └─────────────┘ │    │ └─────────────┘ │
│ │   Columns   │ │    │                 │    │                 │
│ └─────────────┘ │    └─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
└─────────────────┘                           
`}
    </SyntaxHighlighter>
    <h2 {...{

    <h3 {...{
      "id": "1-configuration-setup"
    }}>{`1. Configuration Setup`}</h3>
    <p>{`Configure the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`atlas-trino-extractor.properties`}</inlineCode>{` file:`}</p>
    <SyntaxHighlighter language="properties" style={theme.github} mdxType="SyntaxHighlighter">
      {`
# Atlas connection
atlas.rest.address=http://localhost:21000/
# Trino connection
atlas.trino.jdbc.address=jdbc:trino://localhost:8080/
atlas.trino.jdbc.user=your-username
# Catalogs to extract
atlas.trino.catalogs.registered=hive_catalog,iceberg_catalog
`}
    </SyntaxHighlighter>
    <h3 {...{
      "id": "2-basic-execution"
    }}>{`2. Basic Execution`}</h3>
    <SyntaxHighlighter language="bash" style={theme.github} mdxType="SyntaxHighlighter">

# Extract all registered catalogs
./bin/run-trino-extractor.sh
# Extract specific catalog
./bin/run-trino-extractor.sh -c my_catalog
# Schedule periodic extraction (every 6 hours)
./bin/run-trino-extractor.sh -cx "0 0 */6 * * ?"
`}
    </SyntaxHighlighter>
